items.title: Pay outstanding debt-collection claim
items.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: Wednesday, 02.12.2026. Checked that 2 December 2026 does fall on a Wednesday and is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. The due date is simply the date printed. (To arrive in time via bank transfer, §675s BGB suggests sending the transfer by 01.12.2026 at the latest.)

items.title: Dispute the claim in writing, if contested
items.quote: Wenn Sie die Forderung bestreiten, teilen Sie uns das bitte mit Begründung mit; wir klären den Sachverhalt dann mit unserer Auftraggeberin.
items.computation: The letter gives no explicit deadline for raising a dispute; it is only sensible to do so before the payment deadline of 02.12.2026 to avoid further collection steps, but this is not a stated legal cut-off date, so no exact due date can be derived.

warnings: This is a private debt-collection agency's demand, not a decision by a court or public authority — there is no statutory Einspruch/Widerspruch/Klage period; 'bestreiten' is just an informal way to dispute the underlying claim with the agency.

The IBAN DE20 3705 0198 0005 5664 00 is formally valid (Musterbank AG, BLZ 37050198), but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account — before paying, verify this is genuinely the collection account of Inkassobüro Beispielrecht GmbH (e.g. via their known website/phone number), since paying the wrong account cannot easily be reversed.

The Mahngebühr (€2.50) and Inkassovergütung (€49.00, described as 'nach RVG begrenzt') on a two-month, €79.98 cable/internet bill are relatively high; such ancillary collection fees are often legally capped or disputable — check whether you already received and paid the underlying Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH invoices and whether the prior Mahnung of 12.10.2026 was actually received before accepting these add-on charges.

No proof is shown in the letter that the original creditor (Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH) actually authorised this specific collection agency or that the August/September 2026 invoices were correctly billed; consider asking the collector for the underlying invoices/contract before paying if you are unsure the debt is yours.
